groups.label: Sensitivity
groups.description: In game: Settings → Sensitivity. Every slider runs from 0 to 200 — higher turns the camera faster for the same swipe.

settings.label: General
settings.description: Camera and aim speed when you’re not scoped in — turning, looking around and close-range drag shots.

settings.label: Red Dot
settings.description: Aim speed with a red dot sight. Higher helps fast close-range tracking; too high overshoots the target.

settings.label: 2x Scope
settings.description: Aim speed through a 2x scope, for steady tracking at medium range.

settings.label: 4x Scope
settings.description: Aim speed through a 4x scope. Lower values make small corrections easier at long range.

settings.label: Sniper Scope
settings.description: Aim speed in sniper scopes. Kept lower so you can line up precise long-range shots.

settings.label: Free Look
settings.description: Camera speed while you hold the eye button to look around without moving your aim.

groups.label: Free Look
groups.description: In game: Settings → Sensitivity → Camera Sensitivity (Free Look). Moves only the camera while you hold the eye button — your aim stays put. Tune it for comfortable looking around.

groups.label: Camera
groups.description: In game: Settings → Sensitivity → Camera Sensitivity. Swipe speed when you are NOT firing — turning, checking corners and lining up a shot.

groups.label: ADS
groups.description: In game: Settings → Sensitivity → ADS Sensitivity. Swipe speed WHILE firing. This is what you pull down against recoil, so it matters most for sprays.

groups.label: Gyro
groups.description: In game: Settings → Sensitivity → Gyroscope Sensitivity. How far the view moves when you tilt the phone. Works only with Gyroscope set to Scope On or Always On.

groups.label: ADS Gyro
groups.description: In game: Settings → Sensitivity → ADS Gyroscope Sensitivity. Tilt speed WHILE firing — gyro players tilt the phone down to control recoil.

settings.label: 3rd Person Camera (Character, Vehicle)
settings.description: Eye-button camera speed in third person, on foot or in a vehicle.

settings.label: 1st Person Camera (Character)
settings.description: Eye-button camera speed in first-person mode.

settings.label: Camera (Parachuting)
settings.description: Camera speed while skydiving and parachuting, to scan for landing spots and enemies.

settings.label: 3rd Person No Scope
settings.description: Turning speed in third person without a scope — your main look-around speed.

settings.label: 1st Person No Scope
settings.description: Turning speed in first-person mode without a scope.

settings.label: Red Dot, Holographic, Aim Assist
settings.description: Aim speed with close-range sights (red dot, holographic) and iron sights, before you fire.

settings.label: 2x Scope
settings.description: Aim speed with a 2x scope before you start firing.

settings.label: 3x Scope, Win94
settings.description: Aim speed with a 3x scope and the Win94’s built-in scope.

settings.label: 4x Scope, VSS
settings.description: Aim speed with a 4x scope and the VSS’s built-in scope.

settings.label: 6x Scope
settings.description: Aim speed with a 6x scope. Lower values keep long-range aim steady.

settings.label: 8x Scope
settings.description: Aim speed with an 8x scope for sniping. Kept low for precise shots.

settings.label: 3rd Person No Scope
settings.description: Aim speed while hip-firing in third person.

settings.label: 1st Person No Scope
settings.description: Aim speed while hip-firing in first person.

settings.description: Recoil control while firing with a 6x scope.

settings.description: Recoil control while firing with an 8x scope.
